description: Schema for slot machine market compliance profiles. Every regulatory value is wrapped in a confidence-annotated object so that consultants never cite an unverified number as fact.

confidenceLevels.HIGH: Confirmed from the regulator's official document, the statute text, or the standard body text. Usable as a design baseline.
confidenceLevels.MEDIUM: From a regulator website summary, an authoritative industry source, or a law firm analysis. Usable as a planning assumption but MUST be upgraded to HIGH before certification submission.
confidenceLevels.UNVERIFIED: Not confirmed. A guessed value MUST NOT be filled in. Must be added to verificationRequired.

valueObject.value: The regulatory value. Use null when unknown, and set confidence to UNVERIFIED. Use "none" (string) when the market has been confirmed to impose no such limit.
valueObject.source: Citation precise enough to retrieve: instrument name plus article/section number.
valueObject.notes: Optional. Caveats, measurement basis, engineering implications.

productConstraintKeys.minGameCycleMs: Minimum time from game start to when the next cycle may begin. Note whether it is a hard per-round floor or an average.
productConstraintKeys.maxStakePerSpin: Maximum stake per game round. Note any age or behavioural risk tiering.
productConstraintKeys.maxWinPerRound: Win cap per round or per prize. Note the basis.
productConstraintKeys.turboSlamStop: Any feature that shortens the time to result.
productConstraintKeys.multiGame: Simultaneous play of multiple games, split screen, parallel play.
productConstraintKeys.celebrationOfNonWin: Audio or visual win celebration where the return is less than or equal to the stake.
productConstraintKeys.otherProhibitions: Array of market specific bans that do not fit the keys above.

notes: An absence of a published rule is NOT proof that no rule exists. Many technical limits sit in licence conditions that are not public. Record such cases as UNVERIFIED, not as "none".
This profile is a technical compliance starting point, not legal advice. See steering/jurisdiction-matrix.md section 0.
